messages:
alice: Heads up — Can anyone watching the eu-prod canary for prompt-mux-v2? 25% roll reached ~2m ago and we’re seeing a spike of 502s and error-rate up to ~7%.

deploy-bot: Deployment started: feature-cutover-promptmux v2 -> canary 25% (deploy id: dc3f9e).

oncall-bot: Pager: @dinesh, you are on-call for eu-prod. Error budget burn detected.

dinesh: On it. Looking at logs and routing telemetry now.

ben: Quick logs show repeated `ERROR 502 prompt_router: kernel mismatch selected for model 'pmux'` and `KVCacheMismatch` messages. Appears new endpoint variant picks an incompatible kernel path.

alice: Ok — recommend diverting canary traffic back to the stable route via the feature flag rather than full rollback first. Faster mitigation.

frank: CS: will prep a proactive note for EU customers once we know scope. ETA 10m.

dinesh: Can someone with LaunchDarkly access flip the flag? I don't have the UI session open.

alice: I have access, toggling `pmux_v2_route` -> 0% for eu-prod now.

alice: Running: `curl -s -X POST https://infra.internal/ff/toggle -H 'Authorization: Bearer ****' -d '{"flag":"pmux_v2_route","env":"eu-prod","value":0}'`

deploy-bot: Feature flag change recorded (audit id: ff-acc-4821).

oncall-bot: Change detected: pmux_v2_route -> 0% at 1745002600.

dinesh: Metrics: errors dropping to 0.9% within 60s, p50 latency back to baseline. Canary traffic diverted to stable route.

ben: Good. Hold on a rollback — root cause looks like model-kernel selection issue on the new endpoint. We'll need an eng-runtime + eng-ml fix and added compatibility tests before re-roll.

eva: Creating an incident page and adding the affected tenant list from the last 15m.

frank: CS update: ~12 EU tenants saw failures, ~3 sessions aborted. No sensitive data exposure. Sending templated customer note now.

dinesh: Handing follow-up to ben for the postmortem and remediation. I can stay monitoring for 30m then hand off.

ben: Got it. I'll open INC-1745 with timeline, root-cause hypothesis, and owners (eng-runtime, eng-ml). Adding test case to prevent kernel/variant mismatch.

alice: Thanks everyone. Outcome: FF-divert (snapback) mitigated production impact quickly, canary paused. Next steps: test patch for kernel selection, improve canary health gates, postmortem.

oncall-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Pager cleared.

frank: CS to follow up with affected customers and offer rollback assistance per request.

dinesh: Closing slack thread — please add any follow-ups to INC-1745 and tag relevant teams. :thumbsup:
